boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California Lutheran University
boards.description: Ten currently verified, under-21-safe food and convenience stops around Cal Lutheran, with late access ranging from 11 p.m. service to round-the-clock operation.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 484 Moorpark Road
cards.title: The 3 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A broad late-night menu south of campus
cards.notes: Check the lobby cutoff before leaving; after 10 p.m., plan on using the drive-thru for food served into the early morning.
cards.short_summary: The latest verified restaurant window among the Moorpark Road options on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday and until 2 a.m. Sunday and Monday; the lobby closes at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 484 Moorpark Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 3 a.m. Tuesday-Saturday and 2 a.m. Sunday-Monday; lobby closes at 10 p.m. Verify holiday hours directly.

cards.title: The Weekend 3 A.M. Taco Stop
cards.subtitle: Late drive-thru service near the US-101 corridor
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes, and confirm the day’s schedule before making the longer run from campus.
cards.short_summary: A customizable fast-food stop with especially late Thursday-through-Sunday service.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Monday-Wednesday, 2 a.m. Thursday and Sunday, and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Thousand Oaks, CA — 25 Rancho Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Monday-Wednesday, 2 a.m. Thursday and Sunday, and 3 a.m. Friday-Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: A round-the-clock sit-down option in Newbury Park
cards.notes: Choose this stop when the group needs indoor seating rather than a drive-thru; call ahead if traveling on a holiday.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner west of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Denny's location page identifies the Newbury Park restaurant as open 24 hours every day and says walk-ins are welcome.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open 24 hours Monday-Sunday; Denny's advises contacting the restaurant to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: The After-Midnight Burger Run
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-thru service west of campus
cards.notes: Head west on US-101 and allow time to order before closing; Friday and Saturday provide the latest verified window.
cards.short_summary: A Newbury Park burger stop with seating and service past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru availability, with hours until 1 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Newbury Park, CA, 1550 Newbury Rd.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday-Saturday, with both drive-thru and dine-in seating listed.

cards.title: The Midnight Hillcrest Stop
cards.subtitle: A nightly restaurant and drive-thru window
cards.notes: Aim to arrive well before midnight so the order is placed before closing; both restaurant and drive-thru share the cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A consistent seven-night option when the trip calls for burgers, chili, or a frozen dessert.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Wendy's location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours from 6:30 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Newbury Park — 2790 W Hillcrest Dr
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until midnight seven days a week; check the official page again before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 1928 East Avenida de los Arboles
cards.title: The Arboles 1 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: A late drive-thru on the east side of Thousand Oaks
cards.notes: Keep this east-side location distinct from Rancho Road, and use the drive-thru after its 10 p.m. dining-room cutoff.
cards.short_summary: An alternative late taco stop for trips heading east rather than toward Newbury Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru service until 1 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and until 2 a.m. Friday-Saturday; dine-in closes at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant — 1928 E Avenida De Los Arboles
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Sunday-Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday-Saturday; the listed dine-in cutoff is 10 p.m.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Moorpark Run
cards.subtitle: Late-evening service six nights a week
cards.notes: Use this for an earlier late-night outing and remember that every listed service channel is closed all day Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Moorpark Road choice with dine-in, carry-out, drive-thru, and delivery through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official restaurant page lists dine-in, carry-out, drive-thru, and delivery from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. Monday-Saturday and closure Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Monday-Saturday across listed service channels; closed Sunday. Verify special-date hours before traveling.

cards.title: The All-Night Wilbur Supply Run
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 convenience stop south of campus
cards.notes: Use this for packaged snacks, drinks, or listed hot food when restaurant kitchens have closed; keep the trip focused and brief.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock convenience option near Moorpark Road with hot foods and delivery listed.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven location page identifies the 50 East Wilbur Road store as open 24/7 and lists hot foods among its features.
cards.source_title: 50 E Wilbur Rd in Thousand Oaks, CA | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists 24/7 operation. Late-night inventory and hot-food availability may vary.

cards.title: The Boulevard 24/7 Stop
cards.subtitle: An always-open east-side convenience run
cards.notes: Pick this address when the route already heads east on Thousand Oaks Boulevard; check in-store stock rather than assuming availability.
cards.short_summary: A second round-the-clock option positioned east of the Moorpark Road cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven location page identifies the store at 1773 Thousand Oaks Boulevard as open 24/7 and lists hot foods.
cards.source_title: 1773 Thousand Oaks Blvd in Thousand Oaks, CA | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists 24/7 operation. Specific prepared-food items can vary by time and inventory.

cards.title: The Rancho Conejo Overnight Run
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 fuel-and-food stop in Newbury Park
cards.notes: Combine this stop with a westbound trip when snacks or fuel are needed after midnight; do not assume every hot item is stocked.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open convenience stop with fuel and hot foods listed on the official page.
cards.evidence_claim: The official 7-Eleven location page identifies 609 Rancho Conejo Boulevard at Hillcrest as open 24/7 and lists fuel and hot foods.
cards.source_title: 609 Rancho Conejo Blvd at Hillcrest in Thousand Oaks, CA | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists 24/7 operation; prepared-food selection can change overnight and is not guaranteed.
